title: RBI Amends Payments Bank Governance Directions on Remuneration and Share-Linked Instruments from April 1, 2027
description: RBI's Third Amendment Directions, 2026 revise remuneration disclosures and share-linked instrument norms for Payments Banks from 1 April 2027.The post RBI Amends Payments Bank Governance Directions on Remuneration and Share-Linked Instruments from April 1, 2027 appeared first on TaxGuru.
